integrity: One all-length theorem with complete constructive proof, a standalone integer-arithmetic checker, and explicit boundaries and literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact ordered cyclic length-three multiplicity profiles for binary 010-avoiders only; no read noise, missing windows, reversal quotient, multiple strands, or larger alphabets. Literature equivalence risk in general constrained Markov-type enumeration remains; finite tests do not establish an infinite theorem.
title: Exact cyclic three-gram reconstruction for binary words with no isolated ones
